aggregation: per dimension, take the median ordinal relation only when both evaluators agree on direction or at least 4 of 6 evaluator-by-batch votes support it; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE
worst_case_rule: any supported A_BETTER result on a critical dimension is a critical B regression and blocks pass
minimum_support: every critical dimension must be TIE or B_BETTER with the support threshold; at least one critical dimension must not be INCONCLUSIVE
